title: 預鑄預力雙 T 梁屋蓋
subcategoryTitleEn: Building seismic, precast and fire safety
summary: 從雙 T 梁斷面與屋頂荷載路徑出發，計算預力反拱與長期撓度、缺口梁端吊筋與水平束制力、翼板連接器的隔板剪力，再處理吊裝期間的臨時穩定與連接完成、反拱差與屋面排水、放鬆時端部應力與出廠品質、現場載重試驗，最後談屋面防水與連接器腐蝕、改裝開孔與交接，並以美國職業安全衛生署對邁阿密戴德學院停車場與 Montgomery Mall 雙 T 梁事故的調查報告對照。
summaryEn: Starting from the double-tee section and the roof load path, compute prestress camber and long-term deflection, dapped-end hangers and horizontal restraint forces, and diaphragm shear on flange connectors, then handle temporary stability and completed connections during erection, camber differential and roof drainage, end stresses at transfer and plant quality, and in-situ load testing, and finally roof waterproofing and connector corrosion, alterations and handover, compared with OSHA investigation reports on the Miami Dade College garage and Montgomery Mall double-tee incidents.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「雙 T 梁屋蓋的構成與荷載路徑」與「預力反拱與長期撓度」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Make-up and load path of a double-tee roof" and "Prestress camber and long-term deflection": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 雙 T 梁屋蓋的構成與荷載路徑：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Make-up and load path of a double-tee roof: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「雙 T 梁斷面」如何影響預鑄預力雙 T 梁屋蓋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Double-tee section” governs force, deformation or durability in “Precast prestressed double-tee roofs”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 雙 T 梁由一片薄翼板與兩根腹肋組成：翼板同時是屋面板與受壓區，兩根腹肋內配置預力鋼絞線，像兩根並排的 T 形梁一樣跨越 15 至 30 m 左右的跨度。屋頂荷載包括自重、防水與設備的附加靜載、活載或雪載與積水雨載，經翼板傳到腹肋，再經腹肋端部擱置在倒 T 梁、牆或牛腿上的承壓墊。翼板之間以焊接連接器相連，使整片屋頂成為傳遞風與地震力的隔板。這個系統輕、快、跨度大，但每一個端部與連接器都是關鍵。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「雙 T 梁斷面」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A double tee consists of a thin flange and two stems: the flange is both roof deck and compression zone, while prestressing strands in the stems let the unit span roughly 15 to 30 m like two T-beams side by side. Roof loads, namely self-weight, superimposed dead load from roofing and equipment, live or snow load and ponding rain, pass from the flange into the stems and then through bearing pads at the stem ends onto inverted-tee beams, walls or corbels. Flanges are joined by welded connectors so that the whole roof acts as a diaphragm carrying wind and earthquake forces. The system is light, fast and long-spanning, but every end bearing and connector is critical. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Double-tee section” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching section: flange 3,000×50 mm and two stems averaging 200 mm wide and 750 mm deep, 800 mm overall, so A = 150,000 + 300,000 = 450,000 mm² and self-weight 0.45×24 = 10.8 kN/m (3.6 kPa).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「雙 T 梁是工廠標準品，只要選型號就好，不需要針對屋頂荷載重新檢核。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Double tees are standard plant products, so picking a catalogue size is enough without checking the roof's own loads." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「雙 T 梁斷面」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Double-tee section”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：雙 T 梁是工廠標準品，只要選型號就好，不需要針對屋頂荷載重新檢核。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Double tees are standard plant products, so picking a catalogue size is enough without checking the roof's own loads. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「雙 T 梁屋蓋的構成與荷載路徑」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Make-up and load path of a double-tee roof" is correct?
options: 雙 T 梁是工廠標準品，只要選型號就好，不需要針對屋頂荷載重新檢核。
雙 T 梁由一片薄翼板與兩根腹肋組成：翼板同時是屋面板與受壓區，兩根腹肋內配置預力鋼絞線，像兩根並排的 T 形梁一樣跨越 15 至 30 m 左右的跨度。
預力梁的反拱在出廠後就固定不變。
optionsEn: Double tees are standard plant products, so picking a catalogue size is enough without checking the roof's own loads.

A double tee consists of a thin flange and two stems: the flange is both roof deck and compression zone, while prestressing strands in the stems let the unit span roughly 15 to 30 m like two T-beams side by side.
A prestressed member's camber is fixed once it leaves the plant.
quiz.explanation: 雙 T 梁由一片薄翼板與兩根腹肋組成：翼板同時是屋面板與受壓區，兩根腹肋內配置預力鋼絞線，像兩根並排的 T 形梁一樣跨越 15 至 30 m 左右的跨度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A double tee consists of a thin flange and two stems: the flange is both roof deck and compression zone, while prestressing strands in the stems let the unit span roughly 15 to 30 m like two T-beams side by side. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 雙 T 梁屋蓋的構成與荷載路徑：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Make-up and load path of a double-tee roof: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「雙 T 梁斷面」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Double-tee section” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學斷面：翼板 3,000×50 mm、兩腹肋平均寬 200 mm 高 750 mm，總高 800 mm，A = 150,000 + 300,000 = 450,000 mm²，自重 0.45×24 = 10.8 kN/m（3.6 kPa）。附加靜載 0.5 kPa、屋頂活載 1.0 kPa、跨度 24 m：w_u = [1.2×(3.6+0.5) + 1.6×1.0]×3.0 ≈ 19.56 kN/m，M_u = 19.56×24²/8 ≈ 1,408 kN·m。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching section: flange 3,000×50 mm and two stems averaging 200 mm wide and 750 mm deep, 800 mm overall, so A = 150,000 + 300,000 = 450,000 mm² and self-weight 0.45×24 = 10.8 kN/m (3.6 kPa). With 0.5 kPa superimposed dead load, 1.0 kPa roof live load and a 24 m span: w_u = [1.2×(3.6+0.5) + 1.6×1.0]×3.0 ≈ 19.56 kN/m and M_u = 19.56×24²/8 ≈ 1,408 kN·m. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：結構計算書要列出每種雙 T 梁型號的跨度、斷面、預力配置、設計荷載與屋頂設備位置，並確認雪載、積水雨載與設備集中荷載都有檢核；屋頂平面圖上標示每片雙 T 梁的編號、方向與支承型式。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The structural calculations should list span, section, strand layout and design loads for every double-tee type, confirming that snow, ponding rain and concentrated equipment loads are checked; the roof plan should show every tee's mark, direction and bearing type.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Teaching section: flange 3,000×50 mm and two stems averaging 200 mm wide and 750 mm deep, 800 mm overall, so A = 150,000 + 300,000 = 450,000 mm² and self-weight 0.45×24 = 10.8 kN/m (3.6 kPa). With 0.5 kPa superimposed dead load, 1.0 kPa roof live load and a 24 m span: w_u = [1.2×(3.6+0.5) + 1.6×1.0]×3.0 ≈ 19.56 kN/m and M_u = 19.56×24²/8 ≈ 1,408 kN·m. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「雙 T 梁屋蓋的構成與荷載路徑」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Make-up and load path of a double-tee roof", which statement holds?
options: 雙 T 梁靠自重壓在支承上就很穩定，翼板連接器只是防止高低差的配件。
屋頂只要有排水孔，就不必考慮積水對結構的影響。
optionsEn: Double tees are stable under their own weight, so flange connectors merely prevent level differences.
As long as a roof has drains, ponding need not be considered structurally.
Teaching section: flange 3,000×50 mm and two stems averaging 200 mm wide and 750 mm deep, 800 mm overall, so A = 150,000 + 300,000 = 450,000 mm² and self-weight 0.45×24 = 10.8 kN/m (3.6 kPa).
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching section: flange 3,000×50 mm and two stems averaging 200 mm wide and 750 mm deep, 800 mm overall, so A = 150,000 + 300,000 = 450,000 mm² and self-weight 0.45×24 = 10.8 kN/m (3.6 kPa). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 雙 T 梁屋蓋的構成與荷載路徑：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Make-up and load path of a double-tee roof: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「雙 T 梁斷面」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Double-tee section” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 結構計算書要列出每種雙 T 梁型號的跨度、斷面、預力配置、設計荷載與屋頂設備位置，並確認雪載、積水雨載與設備集中荷載都有檢核；屋頂平面圖上標示每片雙 T 梁的編號、方向與支承型式。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The structural calculations should list span, section, strand layout and design loads for every double-tee type, confirming that snow, ponding rain and concentrated equipment loads are checked; the roof plan should show every tee's mark, direction and bearing type. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計與機電要在初期就確定屋頂設備的位置與重量，並在雙 T 梁配置圖上標示允許集中荷載區；後續新增設備必須由結構技師檢核。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Structural and services teams should fix rooftop equipment locations and weights early and mark allowable concentrated-load zones on the double-tee layout; any later equipment must be checked by the structural engineer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若屋頂設備或增設太陽能板的荷載未納入設計，或排水不良導致積水，腹肋可能出現撓曲裂縫，嚴重時預力鋼絞線屈服；任何一個端部支承失效，整片雙 T 梁就會掉落，因為它沒有其他替代路徑。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If loads from rooftop equipment or added solar panels are left out, or poor drainage lets water pond, the stems can crack in flexure and, in severe cases, strands yield; failure of any single end bearing drops the whole tee, since it has no alternate path. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 結構計算書要列出每種雙 T 梁型號的跨度、斷面、預力配置、設計荷載與屋頂設備位置，並確認雪載、積水雨載與設備集中荷載都有檢核；屋頂平面圖上標示每片雙 T 梁的編號、方向與支承型式。
knowledge.textEn: The structural calculations should list span, section, strand layout and design loads for every double-tee type, confirming that snow, ponding rain and concentrated equipment loads are checked; the roof plan should show every tee's mark, direction and bearing type.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 設計與機電要在初期就確定屋頂設備的位置與重量，並在雙 T 梁配置圖上標示允許集中荷載區；後續新增設備必須由結構技師檢核。
knowledge.textEn: Structural and services teams should fix rooftop equipment locations and weights early and mark allowable concentrated-load zones on the double-tee layout; any later equipment must be checked by the structural engineer.

quiz.question: 要驗證「雙 T 梁屋蓋的構成與荷載路徑」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Make-up and load path of a double-tee roof"?
options: 結構計算書要列出每種雙 T 梁型號的跨度、斷面、預力配置、設計荷載與屋頂設備位置，並確認雪載、積水雨載與設備集中荷載都有檢核。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
預力構件只要加載時沒有斷，就代表通過載重試驗。
optionsEn: The structural calculations should list span, section, strand layout and design loads for every double-tee type, confirming that snow, ponding rain and concentrated equipment loads are checked.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A prestressed member passes a load test as long as it does not break during loading.
quiz.explanation: 結構計算書要列出每種雙 T 梁型號的跨度、斷面、預力配置、設計荷載與屋頂設備位置，並確認雪載、積水雨載與設備集中荷載都有檢核；屋頂平面圖上標示每片雙 T 梁的編號、方向與支承型式。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: The structural calculations should list span, section, strand layout and design loads for every double-tee type, confirming that snow, ponding rain and concentrated equipment loads are checked; the roof plan should show every tee's mark, direction and bearing type. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 雙 T 梁屋蓋的構成與荷載路徑：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Make-up and load path of a double-tee roof: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「雙 T 梁斷面」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Double-tee section” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若屋頂設備或增設太陽能板的荷載未納入設計，或排水不良導致積水，腹肋可能出現撓曲裂縫，嚴重時預力鋼絞線屈服；任何一個端部支承失效，整片雙 T 梁就會掉落，因為它沒有其他替代路徑。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If loads from rooftop equipment or added solar panels are left out, or poor drainage lets water pond, the stems can crack in flexure and, in severe cases, strands yield; failure of any single end bearing drops the whole tee, since it has no alternate path. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這個系統輕、快、跨度大，但每一個端部與連接器都是關鍵。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The system is light, fast and long-spanning, but every end bearing and connector is critical.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「雙 T 梁是工廠標準品，只要選型號就好，不需要針對屋頂荷載重新檢核。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Double tees are standard plant products, so picking a catalogue size is enough without checking the roof's own loads." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若屋頂設備或增設太陽能板的荷載未納入設計，或排水不良導致積水，腹肋可能出現撓曲裂縫，嚴重時預力鋼絞線屈服；任何一個端部支承失效，整片雙 T 梁就會掉落，因為它沒有其他替代路徑。
knowledge.textEn: If loads from rooftop equipment or added solar panels are left out, or poor drainage lets water pond, the stems can crack in flexure and, in severe cases, strands yield; failure of any single end bearing drops the whole tee, since it has no alternate path.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

預力梁的反拱在出廠後就固定不變。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
If loads from rooftop equipment or added solar panels are left out, or poor drainage lets water pond, the stems can crack in flexure and, in severe cases, strands yield.

quiz.explanationEn: If loads from rooftop equipment or added solar panels are left out, or poor drainage lets water pond, the stems can crack in flexure and, in severe cases, strands yield; failure of any single end bearing drops the whole tee, since it has no alternate path. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 預力反拱與長期撓度：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Prestress camber and long-term deflection: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「預力鋼絞線與反拱」如何影響預鑄預力雙 T 梁屋蓋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Strands and camber” governs force, deformation or durability in “Precast prestressed double-tee roofs”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 預力鋼絞線偏心配置在腹肋下方，放鬆後產生向上的彎矩，使雙 T 梁向上拱起，這就是反拱；自重則產生向下撓度。之後混凝土潛變使反拱隨時間增長，但預力損失與附加靜載又會抵銷一部分。對屋頂而言，反拱關係到排水坡度、防水層、與相鄰構件的高差，以及屋面設備與天窗的安裝。PCI 設計手冊提供以乘數估算安裝時與長期撓度的簡化方法。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「預力鋼絞線與反拱」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Strands placed eccentrically low in the stems create an upward moment at release, bowing the tee upward, which is camber, while self-weight produces downward deflection. Creep then increases camber with time, partly offset by prestress losses and superimposed dead load. For a roof, camber affects drainage slope, waterproofing, level differences with adjacent members, and the fit of equipment and skylights. The PCI Design Handbook offers a simplified multiplier method to estimate deflections at erection and in the long term. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Strands and camber” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：I ≈ 3.01×10¹⁰ mm⁴、y_b ≈ 508 mm、e ≈ 408 mm，12 股 15.2 mm 鋼絞線、放鬆後 1,200 MPa：P_i ≈ 2,016 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With I ≈ 3.01×10¹⁰ mm⁴, y_b ≈ 508 mm and e ≈ 408 mm, 12 strands of 15.2 mm at 1,200 MPa after release give P_i ≈ 2,016 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「預力梁的反拱在出廠後就固定不變。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A prestressed member's camber is fixed once it leaves the plant." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「預力鋼絞線與反拱」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Strands and camber”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 預力反拱與長期撓度
knowledge.text: 預力鋼絞線偏心配置在腹肋下方，放鬆後產生向上的彎矩，使雙 T 梁向上拱起，這就是反拱；自重則產生向下撓度。之後混凝土潛變使反拱隨時間增長，但預力損失與附加靜載又會抵銷一部分。
knowledge.textEn: Strands placed eccentrically low in the stems create an upward moment at release, bowing the tee upward, which is camber, while self-weight produces downward deflection. Creep then increases camber with time, partly offset by prestress losses and superimposed dead load.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：預力梁的反拱在出廠後就固定不變。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A prestressed member's camber is fixed once it leaves the plant. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「預力反拱與長期撓度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Prestress camber and long-term deflection" is correct?
options: 預力梁的反拱在出廠後就固定不變。
雙 T 梁端部焊死越牢越好，可以防止滑落。
預力鋼絞線偏心配置在腹肋下方，放鬆後產生向上的彎矩，使雙 T 梁向上拱起，這就是反拱；自重則產生向下撓度。
optionsEn: A prestressed member's camber is fixed once it leaves the plant.
Welding double-tee ends as rigidly as possible is best because it prevents them sliding off.
Strands placed eccentrically low in the stems create an upward moment at release, bowing the tee upward, which is camber, while self-weight produces downward deflection.
quiz.explanation: 預力鋼絞線偏心配置在腹肋下方，放鬆後產生向上的彎矩，使雙 T 梁向上拱起，這就是反拱；自重則產生向下撓度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Strands placed eccentrically low in the stems create an upward moment at release, bowing the tee upward, which is camber, while self-weight produces downward deflection. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 預力反拱與長期撓度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Prestress camber and long-term deflection: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「預力鋼絞線與反拱」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Strands and camber” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：I ≈ 3.01×10¹⁰ mm⁴、y_b ≈ 508 mm、e ≈ 408 mm，12 股 15.2 mm 鋼絞線、放鬆後 1,200 MPa：P_i ≈ 2,016 kN。反拱 P·e·L²/(8E_ci·I) = 2,016,000×408×24,000²/(8×30,000×3.01×10¹⁰) ≈ 65.7 mm，自重撓度 ≈ 51.7 mm，放鬆淨反拱約 14 mm；以長期乘數 2.45、2.70 與附加靜載 3.0 計，最終淨反拱只剩約 2 mm。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With I ≈ 3.01×10¹⁰ mm⁴, y_b ≈ 508 mm and e ≈ 408 mm, 12 strands of 15.2 mm at 1,200 MPa after release give P_i ≈ 2,016 kN. Camber P·e·L²/(8E_ci·I) = 2,016,000×408×24,000²/(8×30,000×3.01×10¹⁰) ≈ 65.7 mm and self-weight deflection ≈ 51.7 mm, a net release camber of about 14 mm; with long-term multipliers of 2.45, 2.70 and 3.0 for superimposed dead load, the final net camber is only about 2 mm. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：工廠在放鬆時與堆置期間定期量測每片雙 T 梁的跨中反拱並記錄日期，與預測曲線比較；出貨前比對同一批相鄰雙 T 梁的反拱差，超過允許值時事先規劃現場調整方式。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The plant measures midspan camber of every tee at release and periodically in storage, recording dates and comparing with the predicted curve; before shipping, compare camber of adjacent tees from the same batch and plan field adjustment in advance where differences exceed tolerance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: I ≈ 3.01×10¹⁰ mm⁴、y_b ≈ 508 mm、e ≈ 408 mm，12 股 15.2 mm 鋼絞線、放鬆後 1,200 MPa：P_i ≈ 2,016 kN。反拱 P·e·L²/(8E_ci·I) = 2,016,000×408×24,000²/(8×30,000×3.01×10¹⁰) ≈ 65.7 mm，自重撓度 ≈ 51.7 mm，放鬆淨反拱約 14 mm；以長期乘數 2.45、2.70 與附加靜載 3.0 計，最終淨反拱只剩約 2 mm。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With I ≈ 3.01×10¹⁰ mm⁴, y_b ≈ 508 mm and e ≈ 408 mm, 12 strands of 15.2 mm at 1,200 MPa after release give P_i ≈ 2,016 kN. Camber P·e·L²/(8E_ci·I) = 2,016,000×408×24,000²/(8×30,000×3.01×10¹⁰) ≈ 65.7 mm and self-weight deflection ≈ 51.7 mm, a net release camber of about 14 mm; with long-term multipliers of 2.45, 2.70 and 3.0 for superimposed dead load, the final net camber is only about 2 mm. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「預力反拱與長期撓度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Prestress camber and long-term deflection", which statement holds?
options: I ≈ 3.01×10¹⁰ mm⁴、y_b ≈ 508 mm、e ≈ 408 mm，12 股 15.2 mm 鋼絞線、放鬆後 1,200 MPa：P_i ≈ 2,016 kN。
雙 T 梁放上承壓墊後就已經穩定，焊接可以等整層吊完再一起做。

Once a double tee sits on its pads it is stable, and welding can wait until the whole level is erected.

quiz.explanationEn: With I ≈ 3.01×10¹⁰ mm⁴, y_b ≈ 508 mm and e ≈ 408 mm, 12 strands of 15.2 mm at 1,200 MPa after release give P_i ≈ 2,016 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 預力反拱與長期撓度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Prestress camber and long-term deflection: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「預力鋼絞線與反拱」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Strands and camber” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 工廠在放鬆時與堆置期間定期量測每片雙 T 梁的跨中反拱並記錄日期，與預測曲線比較；出貨前比對同一批相鄰雙 T 梁的反拱差，超過允許值時事先規劃現場調整方式。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The plant measures midspan camber of every tee at release and periodically in storage, recording dates and comparing with the predicted curve; before shipping, compare camber of adjacent tees from the same batch and plan field adjustment in advance where differences exceed tolerance. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：屋面排水坡度應由支承高程或構件傾斜提供，不應只靠反拱；圖說中標示預估安裝時反拱與允許差值，並要求相鄰雙 T 梁的堆置時間盡量一致。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Roof drainage slope should come from bearing elevations or sloping members rather than camber alone; drawings should show predicted erection camber and allowable differences, and adjacent tees should have similar storage ages where possible.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若屋頂坡度完全依賴反拱，長期反拱縮小或因堆置時間不同而高低不一，屋面在跨中形成低窪積水，增加荷載並加速防水層劣化；反之反拱過大，屋面中央拱起，與牆或天窗的介面產生高差。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If roof slope relies entirely on camber, long-term changes or different storage ages leave low spots at midspan where water ponds, adding load and accelerating membrane deterioration; excessive camber instead bulges the roof centre and creates steps at walls and skylights. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 工廠在放鬆時與堆置期間定期量測每片雙 T 梁的跨中反拱並記錄日期，與預測曲線比較；出貨前比對同一批相鄰雙 T 梁的反拱差，超過允許值時事先規劃現場調整方式。
knowledge.textEn: The plant measures midspan camber of every tee at release and periodically in storage, recording dates and comparing with the predicted curve; before shipping, compare camber of adjacent tees from the same batch and plan field adjustment in advance where differences exceed tolerance.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 屋面排水坡度應由支承高程或構件傾斜提供，不應只靠反拱；圖說中標示預估安裝時反拱與允許差值，並要求相鄰雙 T 梁的堆置時間盡量一致。
knowledge.textEn: Roof drainage slope should come from bearing elevations or sloping members rather than camber alone; drawings should show predicted erection camber and allowable differences, and adjacent tees should have similar storage ages where possible.

quiz.question: 要驗證「預力反拱與長期撓度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Prestress camber and long-term deflection"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
工廠在放鬆時與堆置期間定期量測每片雙 T 梁的跨中反拱並記錄日期，與預測曲線比較；出貨前比對同一批相鄰雙 T 梁的反拱差，超過允許值時事先規劃現場調整方式。

The plant measures midspan camber of every tee at release and periodically in storage, recording dates and comparing with the predicted curve.

quiz.explanation: 工廠在放鬆時與堆置期間定期量測每片雙 T 梁的跨中反拱並記錄日期，與預測曲線比較；出貨前比對同一批相鄰雙 T 梁的反拱差，超過允許值時事先規劃現場調整方式。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: The plant measures midspan camber of every tee at release and periodically in storage, recording dates and comparing with the predicted curve; before shipping, compare camber of adjacent tees from the same batch and plan field adjustment in advance where differences exceed tolerance. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 預力反拱與長期撓度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Prestress camber and long-term deflection: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「預力鋼絞線與反拱」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Strands and camber” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若屋頂坡度完全依賴反拱，長期反拱縮小或因堆置時間不同而高低不一，屋面在跨中形成低窪積水，增加荷載並加速防水層劣化；反之反拱過大，屋面中央拱起，與牆或天窗的介面產生高差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If roof slope relies entirely on camber, long-term changes or different storage ages leave low spots at midspan where water ponds, adding load and accelerating membrane deterioration; excessive camber instead bulges the roof centre and creates steps at walls and skylights. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：PCI 設計手冊提供以乘數估算安裝時與長期撓度的簡化方法。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The PCI Design Handbook offers a simplified multiplier method to estimate deflections at erection and in the long term.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「預力梁的反拱在出廠後就固定不變。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A prestressed member's camber is fixed once it leaves the plant." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若屋頂坡度完全依賴反拱，長期反拱縮小或因堆置時間不同而高低不一，屋面在跨中形成低窪積水，增加荷載並加速防水層劣化；反之反拱過大，屋面中央拱起，與牆或天窗的介面產生高差。
knowledge.textEn: If roof slope relies entirely on camber, long-term changes or different storage ages leave low spots at midspan where water ponds, adding load and accelerating membrane deterioration; excessive camber instead bulges the roof centre and creates steps at walls and skylights.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「預力反拱與長期撓度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Prestress camber and long-term deflection" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
雙 T 梁端部焊死越牢越好，可以防止滑落。
若屋頂坡度完全依賴反拱，長期反拱縮小或因堆置時間不同而高低不一，屋面在跨中形成低窪積水，增加荷載並加速防水層劣化。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Welding double-tee ends as rigidly as possible is best because it prevents them sliding off.
If roof slope relies entirely on camber, long-term changes or different storage ages leave low spots at midspan where water ponds, adding load and accelerating membrane deterioration.
quiz.explanation: 若屋頂坡度完全依賴反拱，長期反拱縮小或因堆置時間不同而高低不一，屋面在跨中形成低窪積水，增加荷載並加速防水層劣化；反之反拱過大，屋面中央拱起，與牆或天窗的介面產生高差。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If roof slope relies entirely on camber, long-term changes or different storage ages leave low spots at midspan where water ponds, adding load and accelerating membrane deterioration; excessive camber instead bulges the roof centre and creates steps at walls and skylights. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
